channels.label: Position
channels.reason: Labelled 'Position' with a DC transducer, so it is body position; a flat trace fits an unchanged posture.

channels.label: TIB_Sx
channels.reason: 'TIB Sx' is the left tibialis leg EMG (Italian sinistra = left).

channels.label: TIB_Dx
channels.reason: 'TIB Dx' is the right tibialis leg EMG (Italian destra = right).

channels.label: MIC
channels.reason: Microphone with a sound transducer, so it is the snore channel.

channels.label: C3
channels.reason: Unreferenced C3 electrode; the contralateral mastoid A2 is recorded separately.

channels.label: C4
channels.reason: Unreferenced C4 electrode; the contralateral mastoid A1 is recorded separately.

channels.label: O1
channels.reason: Unreferenced O1 electrode with A2 recorded separately; its EMG-like trace is consistent with muscle artifact on a scalp lead.

channels.label: O2
channels.reason: Unreferenced O2 electrode; the contralateral mastoid A1 is recorded separately.

channels.label: A1
channels.reason: Mastoid reference electrode, used only as a reference.

channels.label: A2
channels.reason: Mastoid reference electrode, used only as a reference.

channels.label: ROC
channels.reason: Right outer canthus EOG; the label gives no reference.

channels.label: LOC
channels.reason: Left outer canthus EOG; the label gives no reference.

channels.label: ECG1
channels.reason: ECG lead with an ECG trace; paired with ECG2 as its reference.

channels.label: ECG2
channels.reason: Second ECG electrode, used as the reference for ECG1.

channels.label: EMG1
channels.reason: Chin EMG electrode; paired with EMG2 as its reference.

channels.label: EMG2
channels.reason: Second chin EMG electrode, used as the reference for EMG1.

channels.label: Fp2
channels.reason: Frontopolar electrode with no listed canonical target.

channels.label: F4
channels.reason: Unreferenced F4 electrode; the contralateral mastoid A1 is recorded separately.

channels.label: P4
channels.reason: Parietal electrode with no listed canonical target.

channels.label: FP1
channels.reason: Frontopolar electrode with no listed canonical target.

channels.label: F3
channels.reason: Unreferenced F3 electrode; the contralateral mastoid A2 is recorded separately.

channels.label: P3
channels.reason: Parietal electrode with no listed canonical target.

channels.label: F8
channels.reason: Lateral frontal electrode with no listed canonical target.

channels.label: T4
channels.reason: Temporal electrode with no listed canonical target.

channels.label: T6
channels.reason: Temporal electrode with no listed canonical target.

channels.label: F7
channels.reason: Lateral frontal electrode with no listed canonical target.

channels.label: T5
channels.reason: Temporal electrode with no listed canonical target.

channels.label: T3
channels.reason: Temporal electrode with no listed canonical target.

channels.label: TORACE
channels.reason: 'Torace' is Italian for thorax, so this is the thoracic effort belt.

channels.label: ADDDOME
channels.reason: 'Addome' (misspelled) is Italian for abdomen, so this is the abdominal effort belt.

channels.label: STAT
channels.reason: Flat oximeter status channel, not a physiological signal.

channels.label: HR
channels.reason: Heart rate from the oximeter, in BPM.

channels.label: SAO2
channels.reason: Oxygen saturation in % with an SpO2 trace.

channels.label: PLETH
channels.reason: Pulse waveform with a pleth trace.
